question: How do you customize FastAPI's OpenAPI documentation?
title: FastAPI OpenAPI Documentation Customization
direct_answer: FastAPI auto-generates OpenAPI from type hints, docstrings, and parameter descriptions. Customize with: response_model on endpoints, tags and summary/description in decorator, Field() descriptions on Pydantic models, response_description for response docs, and responses dict for error responses. Disable for specific routes with include_in_schema=False. OpenAPI app metadata goes in FastAPI() constructor.
interviewer_intent: Tests whether the candidate maintains API docs as part of the code — documentation-first API design.

sections.title: OpenAPI documentation patterns
sections.content:
FastAPI generates /docs (Swagger UI) and /redoc automatically. The quality depends on what you annotate.

App-level: FastAPI(title, description, version, contact, license_info, openapi_tags) sets the top-level metadata.

Endpoint-level: summary (short), description (Markdown docstring), tags (group endpoints), response_description (describes the success response), responses (documents error responses).

Model-level: Field(description='...') documents each field. model_config with json_schema_extra adds examples. Class docstrings become the model description.

Security schemes: OAuth2PasswordBearer, APIKeyHeader — declare in FastAPI security and add to endpoints with Depends(); they appear in docs with the 'Authorize' button.

Hiding routes: include_in_schema=False on a route excludes it from docs (useful for internal/health endpoints).

sections.title: Documentation patterns
OpenAPI documentation rules
items: Field(description='...') documents each model field in Swagger
tags on endpoints groups them in the sidebar
responses dict documents non-200 status codes
model_config json_schema_extra adds request body examples
include_in_schema=False hides internal routes from docs

seo.metaTitle: FastAPI OpenAPI Documentation — Customizing Swagger Docs
seo.metaDescription: Customize FastAPI OpenAPI docs: endpoint tags, Field descriptions, response schemas, error responses, model examples, and hiding internal routes.

speakable_v2.hook: FastAPI's auto-generated docs are only as good as your type annotations — a few extra Field descriptions and response schemas make the difference between useful docs and useless ones.

beats.content: Field(description='...') and examples show in Swagger for each field. model_config with json_schema_extra adds a full example request body — makes the docs immediately usable by your API consumers.

tags groups endpoints in the sidebar. summary is the one-liner. description supports Markdown for extended explanation. responses dict documents 404, 409, 422 — don't leave error responses undocumented.
include_in_schema=False removes a route from the docs. Use it for internal health checks, admin endpoints, and anything that shouldn't be in the public API contract.

speakable_v2.cap: Good FastAPI docs mean your API consumers can try requests directly from Swagger without reading a separate README. That's the value of keeping annotations accurate.
speakable_v2.followup_handoff: Follow up with generating TypeScript clients from the OpenAPI spec, or API versioning patterns in FastAPI.
